conservation.help_by: Protect shoreline buffers; support mangrove restoration projects.
conservation.caution_against: Don’t clear mangrove roots for beach access or dump trash in lagoons.

life_info.eating: Photosynthetic primary producer. Makes energy from sunlight (and sometimes from clear shallow water light).
life_info.mating: Spreads by spores, seeds, propagules, or creeping rhizomes depending on the species.
life_info.habitat: Drier edges of mangrove forests and coastal thickets. Forms habitat structure that shelters fish, crabs, and invertebrates.

fun_facts: Not always feet-in-water, but still part of the mangrove crew.
Silver-leaf varieties shimmer in coastal wind.
